title: 第13章 解脱第14章 开溜
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 龙墓是位于迷魅森林南部的一座巨型盆地。
据传这里曾经坐落着一座十分强大繁华的古老国度，该国度皇室拥有着可以驾驭飞龙的血脉，凭借着这一天赋，曾四处挑起战争，扩张国土。
史称血龙之乱。
发生在这一纪元之初。
传闻，驭龙的这一种族曾经将国土横推到占据整座大陆的三分之一。
却最终因触犯了不知名的禁忌，一枚来自群星的陨石坠落在其国都皇宫。
再然后，短短不到十年之内，这一国度便分崩离析。
其皇室血脉也就此断绝，国民四处逃难。
然而没有人知道那枚陨石具体给那座王国带来了些什么，致使一座庞大帝国毁于一旦。
如今大陆上最权威的史学家也对此缄口不谈。
真正的秘密应该是被顶层存在掩盖了。
世人只知道，那从天而降的陨石将驭龙帝国曾经的皇宫砸成今天的龙墓盆地。
不过飞龙并未就此灭绝，它们还生活在这一隅之地。
但帝国陨落之后，飞龙似乎也因此遭受了某种诅咒，它们的血脉变得污浊，体魄趋向于孱弱。
它们那本应该遮天蔽日的龙翼退化为后背上的两对附肢，就像霸王龙的前肢一样，几乎毫无用处。
如今的飞龙名不副实，不复往日的强大体魄，且新生的龙都是走地龙。
它们被永久的囚禁在了这片盆地，卑微地等待死亡。
这便是“龙墓”
这一地名的由来。
不过，如今的龙墓中还留存着一头出生在帝国时代的飞龙。
它是如今现存最古老的飞龙，也是龙墓中唯一一头还长有完整龙翼的飞龙。
龙墓中的新生龙种是因为退化了双翼而无法飞天。
而老飞龙则是因为过于年迈，寿元将至，同样无法再振翅翱翔。
它的通体鳞甲已经大面积风化，变成了灰白色泽，庞大的身躯就像一座山岭般匍匐在龙墓中，甚至无法自己挪动，如今只是苟延残喘罢了，等待着属于它的丧钟敲响。
然而龙墓中的龙子龙孙却不愿接受这一现实。
它们一直守护着老飞龙，通过狩猎、献祭等方式，尝试延续老飞龙的生命。
对于如今的走地龙们而言，退化的不仅仅只是它们的血脉体魄，相较于千年前，它们的灵智同样一落千丈，这种供奉、守护的行为只是出于本能。
但其实对老飞龙而言，妥妥的算是一种无止尽的折磨。
看似还在苟活着，可它的大部分身躯却早已经与山脉融为一体。
龙墓中的走地龙，还有大陆上那些追随龙血信仰的信徒们都将它视为神圣，可它不过就是一道被囚禁在残破肢体中的可怜灵魂罢了。
它的内心深处是渴望解脱的。
嗯，珲伍就是这样给宁语解释的。
是解释，而不是忽悠。
他俩从迷魅森林出来之后，在山岭之间七拐八拐，一头就扎进了对世人而言无比凶险恐怖的龙墓盆地。
content_en:
The Dragon Tomb is a giant basin located in the southern part of the Enchanted Forest.
It is said that a very powerful and prosperous ancient country once existed here. The royal family of this country had the bloodline to control flying dragons. With this talent, they once provoked wars and expanded their territory.
Known in history as the Blood Dragon Rebellion.
Occurred at the beginning of this era.
It is rumored that this race of dragon masters once pushed the country to occupy one-third of the entire continent.
But in the end, because he violated an unknown taboo, a meteorite from the stars fell into the palace of his capital.
Then, in less than ten years, the country fell apart.
The royal bloodline was cut off, and the people fled in all directions.
However, no one knows what exactly that meteorite brought to that kingdom, causing a huge empire to be destroyed in one fell swoop.
Today the most authoritative historians on the mainland are silent on this matter.
The real secret should be hidden by the top existence.
The world only knows that the meteorite that fell from the sky smashed the former palace of Yulong Empire into today's Dragon Tomb Basin.
However, the flying dragons have not become extinct, they still live in this corner of the world.
But after the fall of the empire, the flying dragons seemed to have suffered some kind of curse. Their bloodline became dirty and their bodies tended to be weak.
Their dragon wings that were supposed to cover the sky were reduced to two pairs of appendages on their backs, just like the forelimbs of Tyrannosaurus rex, almost useless.
Today's flying dragons are not worthy of their name, they are no longer as powerful as they used to be, and the new dragons are all earthbound dragons.
They are permanently imprisoned in this basin, waiting for death in a humble manner.
This is "Dragon Tomb"
The origin of this place name.
…
However, there is still a flying dragon born in the Empire era in the dragon tomb today.
It is the oldest existing flying dragon and the only flying dragon in the Dragon Tomb that still has complete dragon wings.
The new dragon species in the Dragon Tomb are unable to fly because their wings have degenerated.
The old flying dragon is too old and his life is approaching, so he can no longer fly.
Its scales have weathered over a large area and turned into a gray-white color. Its huge body is crawling in the dragon's tomb like a mountain, and it cannot even move on its own. Now it is just lingering, waiting for its death knell to ring.
However, the dragon sons and grandsons in the dragon tomb are unwilling to accept this reality.
They have been guarding the old flying dragon, trying to extend the life of the old flying dragon through hunting, sacrifice, etc.
For today's earth-moving dragons, it is not only their bloodline and body that has deteriorated. Compared with a thousand years ago, their spiritual intelligence has also plummeted. This kind of worship and protection behavior is just out of instinct.
But in fact, for the old Feilong, it was a kind of endless torture.
It seems to be still alive, but most of its body has already integrated with the mountains.
The earth-moving dragon in the dragon tomb, as well as those believers who follow the dragon blood faith on the mainland, regard it as sacred, but it is nothing more than a poor soul imprisoned in broken limbs.
Deep down it longs for liberation.
Well, this is how Hui Wu explained it to Ning Yu.
It's an explanation, not a lie.
After the two of them came out of the Enchanted Forest, they wandered through the mountains and plunged into the Dragon Tomb Basin, which is extremely dangerous and terrifying to the world.
